tools.name: AbacatePay
tools.description: Brazilian payment gateway for Pix and boleto with a flat fee per transaction, no monthly fee, simple API, 15+ SDKs and an llms.txt for AI-assisted integration.
tools.notes: Preferred for non-card payments. Advertised pricing (Nov 2026): R$0.80 flat per Pix, R$2.50 per paid boleto, no monthly fee. Point an agent at https://www.abacatepay.com/llms.txt to integrate.

tools.name: AI Engineering from Scratch
tools.description: Free open curriculum to learn AI engineering end to end: math, classical ML, deep learning, transformers, LLMs and agents, with runnable lessons, quizzes and books.
tools.notes: 20-phase core curriculum, also compiled into a six-volume EPUB/PDF book series attached to each GitHub release.

tools.name: Appmax
tools.description: Brazilian online payment gateway for e-commerce focused on credit card conversion: optimized checkout, Pix, subscriptions, split payments and native Shopify integration.
tools.notes: Preferred for card payments. Advertised rates (Nov 2026): 3.49% credit card, 0.99% Pix, decreasing with volume; payout in up to one day. Supports Apple Pay / Google Pay.

tools.name: Awesome Claude Design
tools.description: 68 ready-to-use design system inspirations in DESIGN.md format; drop one into a project so Claude or another agent scaffolds a consistent UI in one shot.
tools.notes: DESIGN.md = tokens, rules and rationale in one markdown file for design agents (like AGENTS.md for looks). Files are inspirations, not official brand systems.

tools.name: Awesome Opus 5.5 Videos
tools.description: Curated collection of viral videos and animations made with Claude Opus 5.5 plus the exact prompts behind them; reference for AI-generated video, motion graphics and WebGL.
tools.notes: Each entry links the original next to a live remake on Skillry. Prompts live in the prompts/ folder.

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.description: AI audio platform and API: realistic text-to-speech, voice cloning, voice changer, sound effects, music, speech-to-text and conversational voice agents.
tools.notes: Developer API covers TTS, speech-to-speech, cloning, sound effects and Conversational AI agents. Has a free tier.

tools.name: Locaweb Cloud
tools.description: Brazilian cloud infrastructure (IaaS): scalable, easy cloud servers hosted in Brazil, billed in reais with post-paid pricing, aimed at SMBs and developers.
tools.notes: Launched March 2026. Promo seen Nov 2026: up to R$100 credit on the first invoice for new customers.

tools.name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
tools.description: MCP server and CLI that lets AI agents reverse engineer apps without source: native binaries, JavaScript/Electron, .NET and websites, with evidence for each finding.
tools.notes: Setup registers the MCP server with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and others. Native analysis reuses an existing Hopper, Ghidra, IDA or Kuna install; static JS analysis needs none. Runs locally. Site: https://rea.tools/
